sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, the clypeal plate paler, body pale brown; antennae, femora and tibiae tinged with brown, tarsi yellow; wings pale brown, the veins brown, with a subcostal streak. Setae fairly dense on the head, pronotum and dorsum of the abdomen, the wing surface punctate and densely covered with short setae. Head broadly oval, narrowed anteriorly; compound eyes rather large and strongly projecting; ocelli medium-sized, about one ocellus diameter from the compound eye. Fontanelle slit-like, surrounded by a fine oval line, slightly raised; anterior margin of the transverse band concave; clypeal plate short, rather strongly raised. Antenna 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Pronotum trapezoidal, the anterior corners short and rounded, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave; the incision of the mesonotum slightly deeper than that of the metanotum, the metanotal projection broadly rounded; media forked beyond the middle, with 2—3 branches; cubitus with 6—7 branches. Measurements: body length with wings 14 mm, without wings 8.5 mm, fore wing 11—11.5 mm, head length 1.82 mm, head width 1.6 mm, pronotum width 1.22 mm, length 0.57 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head black, the tip of the nasus tinged with red, body tinged with brown; antennae blackish brown, femora and tibiae tinged with brown, tarsi pale. Head hairless, the posterior abdominal tergites with a row of posterior setae. Head pear-shaped, the nasus rather long; the swelling at the antennal socket small; the frontal outline with a depression. Antenna 14-segmented, segment 3 equal in length to segment 2, segment 4 distinctly longer than segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 3.5 mm, head length including nasus 1.6 mm, head length without nasus 0.8 mm, pronotum width 0.49 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Coloration and pilosity as in lacessitus, differing only slightly in body size. Measurements: body length 4.5—5 mm, pronotum width 0.53 mm.

note: Adapted from the species-level description by Holmgren (1913), original in German; includes imago, soldat and arbeiter, the original measurements in mm. The soldier head width and the worker head width are damaged by OCR in the Internet Archive scan (rendered as "0,o" and "l,u") and have not been entered in the entry.
